core_rule: Authors write stories from specific times, places, and cultures. Readers must look at context to understand why characters act, think, or speak in certain ways.

hint_levels.template: Does character action match world they live in or your own world?
Find <historical event> or <cultural belief> in text and link to character choice.
Reading without context is like watching sport without knowing rules.

worked_example.question: In 'The Rabbits' by John Marsden, why do rabbits wear uniforms?
worked_example.answer: Uniforms represent colonial power and military control over land.

steps.instruction: Connect to historical context of colonisation.

worked_example.explanation: Uniforms show authority. Context of Australian history explains why these figures take land.

learning_objectives: Objective 1: Identify how historical or cultural context shapes character actions.
Objective 2: Analyse how authors use setting to reflect social issues.

explanation_sections.heading: What is Context?
explanation_sections.body: Context is world behind story. Includes time, place, and culture. Shapes how characters see life.

explanation_sections.heading: How to Analyse Context
explanation_sections.body: 1. Note when/where story happens. 2. List character beliefs. 3. Ask: Does history change how they act?

explanation_sections.heading: Model Text Example
explanation_sections.body: Bush poem describes heat as 'enemy'. Context: Early settlers struggled with harsh Australian climate. Effect: Shows nature as powerful force.

explanation_sections.heading: Common Pitfall: Judging by Today
explanation_sections.body: Do not judge past characters by modern rules. Understand their world first.

key_vocabulary.definition: Time, place, and culture surrounding text.

common_mistakes: Applying modern values to past characters.
real_world_connections: Understanding news reports from different countries.
Interpreting movies based on true events.

additional_worked_examples.question: How does bush setting change character in Australian short story?
additional_worked_examples.answer: Bush forces character to be self-reliant.
